content:
sam: FYI — customer reported being billed for the same stream tokens twice after a reconnect where a toolcall response was truncated. Repro steps and logs below.

sam: logs:
```
[router] session_id=abc123 reconnect after 10s idle
[toolcall] id=tc-42 truncated=true final_ack=none
[billing] provisional_credits: +152 then +152 on resume
```

sam: This looks like streaming + toolcall chains where a reconnect causes us to replay a prefix and we end up re-charging provisional credits that later get confirmed again.

anika: Can you paste the request/response ids from the tenant? Is the client sending any idempotency or session tokens?

sam: tenant request id: rq-9f2, client session_id=abc123, no client idempotency header. Router resumes using our session stitching.

ryan: Quick context: our current heuristic marks token credits as provisional until a final ack. On reconnect we stitch prefixes and may re-emit the same token stream segments; if provisional had already been counted and later confirmed again we can see double-charge in the billing export until reconciliation kicks in.

maria: Console only shows final confirmed credits; accounting export shows provisional reconcile steps. Customer saw a spike in the billing CSV and flagged it. Reconciliation lag is the UX problem here.

sam: Short-term proposal: dedupe at resume using (toolcall_id + sequence range) so replayed chunks that overlap already-charged ranges are dropped. Also surface "provisional credits" in the Console with a hover note. Long-term: change semantics so truncated toolcalls don't provision credits until we receive a toolcall-final marker from the model service.

ryan: Implementation note: router can attach last_seen_seq and toolcall_id on resume packets. Ingress can check ledger for overlapping ranges and drop duplicates. Risk: dropping legitimately missing tokens could undercharge or break client expectations.

anika: Alternative: keep provisional model but improve visibility and faster reconciliation. If duplicates show up, billing pipeline can annul duplicates. But reconciliation latency is the customer-facing problem.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-451 assigned to @ryan @anika

sam: UX ask for Console: add a small toggle "show provisional credits" and an inline explanation near route quota: "Provisional credits are held until final ack; may be reconciled later." Low risk, helps support.

ryan: Action items: 
- RFC for conservative provisional semantics (ryan) — target: EOD +3
- Router patch: include toolcall_id on resume packets + de-dupe logic (anika) — PR by tomorrow
- Console flag mock + tooltip (maria) — prototype by EOW

maria: I'll add a dashboard panel showing provisional vs confirmed daily delta and link to ledger rows for drilling-in.

anika: I'll roll a small feature flag to enable ingress de-dupe for 1% traffic to validate.

sam: Please ping billing-infra as well; customers want a remediation path for visible double charges.

dev-bot: deploy status: canary rollout started at 1767812000 for router patch (patch-id: rtr-dedupe-1)

ryan: Filing the customer remediation ticket now and will coordinate credits reversal if reconciliation fails.

sam: thanks all — let's sync tomorrow at the 10:30 engineering standup if there are blockers.
